import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 打劫记录
 * 指令：/打劫记录 [页码]
 *
 * 展示被打劫的记录，每条记录附带[回击]按钮
 */

import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/robberyRecord/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  // 提取页码
  const pageMatch = e.MessageText.match(/(\d+)/);
  const page = pageMatch ? Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(pageMatch[1]), 100)) : 1;

  const result = await App({ bid, uid, page, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '打劫记录', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (result.data.records.length === 0) {
    md.addText('暂无被打劫记录');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '打劫记录', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  for (const r of result.data.records) {
    md.addNewline();
    const time = dayjs(r.createdAt).format('MM-DD HH:mm');
    const lines = [`${time} ${r.typeText} ${r.resultText}`, `${r.attackerDisplayName} → 你`];

    if (r.lossText) {
      lines.push(r.lossText);
    }

    if (r.dropText) {
      lines.push(r.dropText);
    }

    md.addBlockquote(createQuoteMarkdown(lines, r.canCounterAttack ? [{ label: '回击', command: `/回击 ${r.id}` }] : []));
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '打劫记录',
      content: md,
      nav: {
        current: result.data.currentPage,
        total: result.data.totalPages || 1,
        count: result.data.total,
        command: '/打劫记录 {page}'
      }
    })
  );
});
